Nor seek to know the look of that which dies
Importuning Life for life. Walk not in woe,
But, for a little, let your step be slow.

Though white of bloom as it had been before
And proudly waitful of fecundity-
One little loveliness can be no more;
And so must Beauty bow her imperfect head
Because a dream has joined the wistful dead!" - Dorothy Parker

We have completed our study of field topology around the anomaly using the latest set of experiment data. Our results indicate that we are looking at a 3D matrix of 4D objects.

That is to say, this is a Tesseract Matrix.

Of course, this is only a projection of the actual object into our world space. To understand the properties of the source, we need to gather observations from multiple perspectives. 

For this, we will need some help.

We are putting together some text for the intergalactic craigslist ad for some lab staff, and to see if anyone wants this old uranium centrifuge.

Thank you for responding to our intergalactic craigslist ad for help on studying this very not-dangerous-at-all, anomaly. Please take a seat inside the last pod by the hatch, and make sure to disable the O2 and Fuel alarms. If you need to dispose of the previous occupant, please use the bins on your left.

On your mission today, we are going to be analyzing the topology of an electro-gravitic space-fridge-time anomaly. Our current data suggests that this is a 3D projection of 4D objects, a tessaract matrix.

Please use the pod provided to get as dangerously close to the anomaly as safely possible, and then proceede a little further. 

The data you capture will be very pretty. And also useful!

6528.d:
"Au pied de la lettre" is a generative kufi-inspired roman typography.
In its artistic approach, this piece does not use any text based function and generates letters dynamically, as shapes. 

Each mint is generated with its own typographic variations of ascender, descender and crossbar, then takes an input message and creates a unique tile from it in the shape of a square, a star or a cross. 

"Au pied de la lettre" means "literally" as this piece uses literally the hash as the message to be displayed, giving the mint its uniqueness. Whatever the hash is, readableness is futile, style is the message here.


- David Esq.

6531.d:
Simple Shapes aims to create complex and suprising patterns that would be hard to conceptualize without the iterative power of code. All patterns in the result set are derived by only the use of simple shapes moving around the perimeter of another simple shape. The apothem of the pattern shape may oscillate, and the speed at which the shapes move around the pattern and rotate while doing so may change, but in the end, it's just lines, triangles, squares, octagons etc...

-Features-

-Pulse Factor is inversely proportional to the viewport and refers to the maximum growth for the radius of the pattern shape which creates the pulsing effect;

-Pattern speed is the speed at which shapes move around the perimeter of the pattern.

-Shape rotation speed is the speed/direction at which shapes are rotating individually

-Controls-

[mouse click] - pause animation
[s] - save .png

My love of physics predates my love for generative systems. This piece explores the compositional beauty that can arise from particle collisions in the subatomic space. The aesthetic is based on bubble chamber photography: the paths of particles are traced and photographed as they split and collide.

The primary particle travels at extreme speeds, looping around until it collides with another particle. The resulting explosion is traced out and interesting events are highlighted. Some of the particles shoot off at incredible velocity, and others spiral tighter and tighter until they blink out of existence.

This is a study in composition.

6644.d:
117P9H3V0 is a c/3 orthogonal spaceship discovered by David Bell in May 1992. It is based on a period-3 spaceship with a front engine related to dart and a loosely connected back component which could be removed to form a period-9 spaceship, being the first spaceship of this period to be found. The back part creates a blinker, which is deleted later. It provides three sparks in generation 1.

In September 1997 Bell found a smaller period-3 component to support the period-9 trailing edge. In June 2001 Paul Tooke found a much smaller period-9 spaceship, 55P9H3V0.

On December 25, 2020, Chris Rowett found a small tagalong for the spaceship using a combination of ikpx2 and apgsearch.

6671.d:
Quasiflock is a 2022 rework of a 2006 realtime animated generative system, originally one of the projects from which later my toxiclibs library collection and some other big client projects & brand identities grew out of. The piece was part of a long, multi-year investigation into particle systems, agents and the aesthetic of fluid dynamics. Even though the approach used here is very primitive, my overall aim was to create a dynamic (and minimally interactive/responsive) system, which is above all mesmerizing to watch and somewhat feels alive. Since the original Java/Processing version isn't able to run anymore, I did some major updates and ported it to Zig & WebAssembly to give it a new life, more fluidity and a larger audience. Hope you enjoy!

10 parametric color themes (each with variations)
10 macro design/behavioral params (to control dozens more)
optionally mouse/touch responsive (rotate/pulsate)...

Made w/ Zig, WASM & thi.ng/umbrella

6696.d:
In the formation of a supernova, all the hydrogen is used up and a given star undergoes a sudden increase in brightness, with variations that can reach 19 magnitudes (about 100 times brighter than an ordinary nova). The glow caused by the explosion of a supernova can take weeks or even months to disappear. Supernovae represent the beginning of the final phase of evolution of massive stars.

The explosion results from uncontrolled thermonuclear reactions that occur inside these stars, as a result of which matter is launched into space at great speeds. In this explosion, up to 90% of the star can be thrown into space. The remaining mass appears in the form of an expanding gas cloud and possibly a compact stellar object, which could be a neutron star or a black hole.

6733.d:
A multimedia NFT that generates a unique beat and sandbox. Then you start beats and sand grains will vibrate & change colors according to real sound waves.

You can pause, restart, increase number of sand grains up to 4M and resolution up to 4K.

This is n°2 in my diptych of generators of sand-like particle systems driven by beat waves.
N°1 in diptych is focused on early-stopped systems producing cool static visuals and mintable there -> https://www.fxhash.xyz/generative/slug/sandbeats-diptych-1

WARNING: Webgl/GPU compliant, CPU compliant but might lag with 1M/4M particles, runs on Mobile but lags.

Controls:
- H: hide/show help.
- Dbl-Click - Space: start/pause animation for snapshots.
- S - Z/W: particles more/less (256^2, 512^2, 1024^2, 2048^2).
- Q/A - D: resolution down/up (720p, 1080p, 2K, 4K, 8K).
- R: restart animation from scratch.
- I: hide/show info panel. Click for panels (info, FPS).

SandBeats Diptych #2 @naibdian 2021 using Opensource WebGL, ReactJS, ThreeJS libs.

6738.d:
Architectural, volumetric perception even it it seems chaotic follow mathematical rules designed.

This generate a minimalistic volume definition fading from a single color (with different intensity and transparency) into a gray scale.

The different color grade from the beginning to the end, even on the same structure generate a different perception of the space.

By "clicking" you restart the process starting from different color, slightly different transition to gray and different levels of transparency.

Sometime volumes are very minimal and almost unperceivable, sometime, with a very bright background you want to leave the space to reveal slowly.
 
Architecture is a form of abstraction in perspective

6744.d:
NATURAL 01 are generative loops and animated pieces creating a fullscreen visual based on a noise. It’s the first part of a collection.
The size, position and motion frequency of trails are generated for each token, along with the color theme.  Movements are generated by a flow based on a noise.
You can press spacebar to stop the animation.

 Features :
	- Generated grid between 50 and 90 cols and rows
	- 2 kind of shapes (circles and squares) : sometimes it can be full of squares or circles 👀
	- Shapes can be stroked or filled : sometimes it can be full stroked or filled 👀
	- Direction : Motion based on sinus, cosinus or tan (« circular »)
	- Background color :  color randomly get from 1 of 148 color themes

Created by Quentin Hocdé, in Brussels (Belgium).
